_readme: verify-context-coverage detection vocabulary + frozen references (context-defaults-economy task 1.4, design.md '门禁合同 — verify:context'). Versioned v1: the vocabulary is an EXACT enumeration (no wildcards) — extending it is a version bump, never an edit in place. frozenAvailability mirrors the variant grammar's frozen table (openspec/changes/archive/2026-08-27-variant-grammar/design.md §4, authoritative) — the gate asserts bidirectional equality (values ≡ table row) against this mirror, so a table change there must land here in the same change. The 2.1 pilot additions extend the mirror for the two proxy families whose paint slots restate a frozen row's domain rather than mint one: button-group (the zone's four-value domain — a structural provider family, own = the silent rung its children fall to) and icon-button (press-button's whole five-value ladder restated verbatim, the X2-11 restate decision; the grammar itself rules 'IconButton forwards the new union, not a separate color decision'). slot-values-first (2026-09-04): slotFactories is the values-first factory vocabulary — generic:true marks the two explicit-type-argument faces (absentSlot, defineOpenSlot) with no values tuple to infer from; definePaintSlot's first argument (the inline values tuple) IS the family union's source, and paintVariantUnion is asserted against that tuple — the same-folder-union extraction ceiling is retired. Domain notes (reconcile r2, 2026-09-04): the physics texture axis is OUTSIDE this economy by ruling — press-button's `raised` resolves `explicit ?? zone ?? true` over PRESS_TEXTURE_KEY (its own zone key, written by ButtonVariantScope), never a Defaults slot, because physics flows through joined groups while paint does not; it is not a vocabulary word and carries no exemptions entry. Single-file non-item components under registry/files/ui/ root (search-palette.svelte, a site composition) are out of gate reach — zero props today; registering them or moving them into a family folder is the remedy if they ever grow a style vocabulary. pilotFamilies below serves manual --scope=pilot runs only; the gate itself scans every registry:ui family.
